Package com.example.lotterize.ui.home

Class HomeFragment

Fragment
com.example.lotterize.ui.home.HomeFragment
All Implemented Interfaces:
FilterFragment.FilterFragmentsDialogListener
public class HomeFragment extends Fragment implements FilterFragment.FilterFragmentsDialogListener
Displays events that user can join waitlist for along with text search, QR search, and info about the lottery. User can also filter events using filters and availability date.
